EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2877–2964 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), no O–H/N–H stretches (disfavoring 4 and a secondary amide like 2), and a prominent band at 1664 cm⁻¹ consistent with the N=O stretch of an alkyl nitrite R–O–N=O. Supporting nitrite/nitro-group vibrations appear at 826 cm⁻¹ (δ(NO₂/ONO), GFQ-022) and multiple bands in the 900–1000 cm⁻¹ region attributable to N–O/C–O modes. The CH2-dominant deformation/twist features near 1454 and 1341 cm⁻¹ are more consistent with a primary alkyl nitrite (pentyl nitrite) than a more branched isopropyl nitrite.
